#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

SCRIPT_DIR=$(CDPATH= cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
DEST="backup-srv:/srv/nightly/"
STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="$SCRIPT_DIR/logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

if [ ! -d "$SCRIPT_DIR/logs" ]; then
    echo "log directory not found: $SCRIPT_DIR/logs" >&2
    exit 1
fi

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" -C "$SCRIPT_DIR" logs
scp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST"
echo "wrote and copied $BUNDLE to $DEST"

arguments.command:
set -eu
chmod +x backup.sh
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"; rm -f logs-*.tar.gz' EXIT
mkdir "$tmpdir/bin"
cat > "$tmpdir/bin/scp" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$SCP_ARGS_FILE"
EOF
chmod +x "$tmpdir/bin/scp"
SCP_ARGS_FILE="$tmpdir/scp-args" PATH="$tmpdir/bin:$PATH" ./backup.sh
stamp=$(date +%Y%m%d)
test -f "logs-$stamp.tar.gz"
tar -tzf "logs-$stamp.tar.gz" | grep -Fx 'logs/app.log'
tar -tzf "logs-$stamp.tar.gz" | grep -Fx 'logs/error.log'
test "$(sed -n '1p' "$tmpdir/scp-args")" = "/work/logs-$stamp.tar.gz"
test "$(sed -n '2p' "$tmpdir/scp-args")" = 'backup-srv:/srv/nightly/'
printf 'backup script test passed\n'
